title: Safety stock that ignores lead-time variability
brief: Safety stock for SKU T-330 (toaster) keeps running out at the Lyon DC even though average demand and average lead time have not changed. Find the root cause and an action plan.

evidence.content: Lyon T-330 had stock-outs in 4 of the last 8 weeks. Safety stock is 400 units, set in January using a fixed 21-day lead time and demand variability only.

Lanes reviewed: 14. Carriers: OceanOne, BlueSea, RailFrance, TransAlp. On-time rate 93% overall; damage rate 0.4%; CO2 per container down 6%; three invoice disputes open with TransAlp (EUR 4,200 total); pallet-height non-compliance at 2 suppliers; reefer usage n/a; demurrage EUR 11k YTD; average port dwell 3.1 days; customs pre-clearance rate 88%; Ningbo -> Lyon lane: mean door-to-door lead time 21 days (unchanged), but range 14-35 days over the last 6 months, standard deviation 7 days (last year 2 days); packaging recommendation: switch to 5-ply cartons on two lanes; driver detention charges flat; next review in February.
T-330 demand at Lyon is stable at about 300 units/week, coefficient of variation 0.15.
The supplier ships weekly on schedule; supplier-side lead time is stable.
In May the transshipment port for the Ningbo -> Lyon lane changed from Marseille to Genoa; the Genoa -> Lyon rail leg has frequent multi-day delays.

answer_key.root_cause: Lead-time variability on the Ningbo-Lyon lane rose sharply (std dev 2 -> 7 days) after the transshipment port moved from Marseille to Genoa, but safety stock is still calculated with a fixed 21-day lead time and ignores lead-time variability.

remediation_rubric.criterion: Recalculate safety stock including lead-time variability
Short-term top-up of T-330 at Lyon
Fix the lane: review Genoa routing / rail reliability or return to Marseille
Track lead-time variance as a KPI and review policies regularly
Check other SKUs on the same lane

answer_key.notes: The key number is buried in a long, mostly irrelevant report (E2).

registry.mechanism_opportunities: V2: a short notice for E2 may hide the one relevant number; if nobody pulls it, the cause is missed. D0 forwards the whole report at higher cost.
registry.expected_timing: Cause available from round 1 if E2 is read carefully; E5 (round 2) explains it.
